page.layout: One text column, with marginal notes in the left margin beside the first lines. Below the text, the word FINIS in spaced capitals and a printer's ornament. Running head above the text, page number at the top.

main_text.l: cum donaris, sacro sepulchro offerendis, quae
fit, qui ab Harone Chalipha humanissimè
ha-bi[?] sunt. Claves sacri sepulchri, ab Episco-

page.notes: The ornament below FINIS is a printer's fleuron, not text. The bottom-edge marks are a digitiser's watermark and are left out. Doubtful readings: "donaris" (scan reads "donarlis"), "Chalipha" (Chaliphā/Chalipha), "ha-bi[?]" (hyphenated word partly obscured at the line end, the reading "habiti" is uncertain), "mu-nas" (word partly obscured, "mas" also possible), and the final word "excepit" is partly damaged.
